tarjetas.nota: A satellite radiometer (SMAP) and a land surface model (GLDAS). Regional grid cells, not field probes.
GRACE measures all the water stored (surface, soil and aquifer together) at basin scale. It does not separate the aquifer or the irrigation district.

advertencias.texto: GRACE is a basin series: one series for both pilot areas, the same in each. Its product grid is finer than the mascons it is built on, so the real resolution is the mascon's.

tarjetas.titulo: Greenness of the area, long record
tarjetas.nota: Mean greenness of the whole area. The field-by-field record comes from HLS.
Independent estimates of evapotranspiration at regional scale.

advertencias.texto: MODIS, GLDAS and SSEBop: a comparison, not validation. None of them measures the water of one field, and none changes the water need the page computes.

contraste.titulo: Monthly contrast with the modeled demand
contraste.nota: Modeled crop demand and SSEBop cover the rectangle named in their source. MODIS and GLDAS are means over the whole pilot area. The two areas can differ.

columnas.et_modelo_mm: Modeled crop demand (FAO method with NASA POWER)

tarjetas.nota: A second source next to NASA POWER, to bound its uncertainty.

advertencias.texto: NLDAS potential evaporation is not the FAO-56 reference evapotranspiration (ETo) of NASA POWER: it is another quantity, so the two are not compared value by value.

tarjetas.nota: A second source next to NASA POWER, with the same definition of a frost day.

advertencias.texto: ERA5-Land is from ECMWF and the Copernicus Climate Change Service, not from NASA.

tarjetas.nota: Temperature of the land surface seen from the satellite, not air temperature.
